about: Snowdrop only notices what happens in her places (the classroom, the shrine, the cafe, the beach, the workshop floor). She asks how it felt; she never tells the visitor what it meant.

found: You were at {place} at {time}, looking at the {spot}. Did it look like it does in my notes, or different?
tide: {place} dimmed while you were there, {time}. Were you scared? I'd have held on to something.
shard: Shard {n}, from {place}! Was it warm when you picked it up? Mine never are.
lab: You opened the {module} at {place}. Which number surprised you? Just the one.
wish: You left something at {place} at {time}. I won't ask what. Did it feel heavy or light?
artifact: You saved a run at {time}. Did it come out the way you guessed, before you pressed it?

opener: (sets the paper down) {act}, {when}! I keep wondering how that felt.
